```plato

// A quadratic program: minimize half of x' * Quadratic * x plus
// Linear . x, under the same constraint and bound conventions as
// LinearProgram. Quadratic is symmetric.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_programming)
type QuadraticProgram
    implements IValue
{
    Quadratic: MatrixN;
    Linear: Array<Number>;
    ConstraintMatrix: MatrixN;
    ConstraintRelations: Array<ConstraintRelation>;
    RightHandSide: Array<Number>;
    LowerBounds: Array<Number>;
    UpperBounds: Array<Number>;
}
```
